I found Diana's body in weapons. I just arrived there at the end of my route. My path was: oxygen → upper engine → medbay → electrical → security → weapons. Along the way I saw Eve in upper engine early on (ticks 2-3), then she headed to oxygen at tick 4. I also saw Bob in electrical for several ticks (8-10) — looked like he was doing a task there. So Eve and Bob both have partial alibis with me. That leaves Alice and Frank unaccounted for in my sightings. I'd like to hear where they were, especially anyone who was near weapons.

Charlie's account of me matches up — I was in upper engine early with him, then went to oxygen. After that I came back through upper engine (saw Frank there around tick 9), then down to lower engine and finished at storage. I never went anywhere near weapons, so I can vouch that Charlie's route at least started in upper engine like he said.

One thing worth noting: I saw Frank in upper engine at tick 9. Weapons is on the far side of the map from there, so if Frank was the killer he'd have needed time to get to weapons after that. Charlie said he saw Bob in electrical around ticks 8-10, which would also make it hard for Bob to be in weapons. I want to hear from Alice and Frank — especially Alice, since no one has placed her anywhere yet.

I was not on the weapons side at the end. My route was electrical first, then medbay, then cafeteria, and I came down toward storage/lower engine where I was when the report happened. I didn’t really cross paths with anyone, so I don’t have a strong hard vouch.

I will say Eve’s point doesn’t fully clear Frank for me — upper engine around tick 9 still gives enough time to go upper engine → cafeteria → weapons before Charlie reports. Not saying that’s definitely what happened, but I don’t think “he was upper engine at 9” clears him from a weapons body. Bob being in electrical ticks 8-10 sounds a little better if Charlie really saw him there. So right now I’m most interested in Frank’s route.

Alright, let me lay out my route clearly since I'm being asked about it. I started in lower engine, went up to upper engine, then to oxygen, then cafeteria, and I ended in medbay where I was when Charlie called the meeting. I was never in weapons, never in security, never in electrical.

On Eve's claim — she says she saw me in upper engine at tick 9. That's slightly off from my view: I saw Eve in upper engine at tick 8, and she left upper engine at tick 9 heading to lower engine. So we did cross in upper engine, that part lines up, but notice she said she went oxygen → upper engine → lower engine → storage. That matches what I saw.

Now, to Alice's point about whether I could've made it to weapons — let's check the geometry. From upper engine at tick 9, to get to weapons I'd need to go upper engine → cafeteria (2) → weapons (2), so I'd arrive at weapons around tick 13 at earliest. Possible, sure. But I actually went upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → medbay, and I was in cafeteria passing through, not weapons. I didn't see a body in cafeteria when I went through it.

Honestly, what stands out to me is Alice. She says her route was electrical → medbay → cafeteria → toward storage/lower engine, and admits she has no vouches. But Charlie said Bob was in electrical ticks 8-10 doing a task, and Charlie passed through electrical too — yet Alice claims she was in electrical and nobody saw her there. Her route also takes her through cafeteria, which is adjacent to weapons. That's the path I'd watch.

I'm leaning Alice, but I want to hear Bob confirm whether he saw Alice in electrical before I commit.

Okay, this is important — let me lay out what I actually saw because some of what's been said doesn't fully match my view.

My route was: weapons → security → electrical → medbay → upper engine. Yes, I started in **weapons**. I was there early in the round and Diana was NOT there when I left — I moved to security where I saw Diana at ticks 2, 3, and 4. So Diana was alive in security early on, not in weapons. Whoever killed her in weapons did it later.

Then I went to electrical, where I saw Charlie arrive from medbay at tick 7 and stay through ticks 8-10. So Charlie's claim about being in electrical lines up with my view, and his claim about seeing me in electrical 8-10 also lines up. We can vouch for each other in that window.

Now here's the critical part: **Alice claims she was in electrical before medbay.** I was in electrical from roughly tick 5 onward, and Charlie was there 7-10. Neither of us saw Alice in electrical. That's a direct contradiction with her stated route.

Also, Frank's geometry argument actually works against Alice too — she places herself going through cafeteria, which is adjacent to weapons, and she has no vouches and her electrical claim doesn't hold up.

I'm voting Alice.

I already gave my speech earlier, but since we're going around again let me add what I'm thinking now after hearing everyone.

Bob's point is the key one for me. I was in electrical from tick 7 through tick 10, and I can confirm Bob was there with me from tick 8 onward. Neither of us saw Alice in electrical. That's a hard contradiction with her stated route — she said electrical was her FIRST stop, which would've been even earlier, but Bob says he was there from around tick 5. So Alice's electrical claim doesn't line up with two independent witnesses.

Combined with the fact that Alice has no vouches and her route takes her through cafeteria (adjacent to weapons), I think she's the most likely suspect. Frank's route is plausible and Eve and Bob both have alibis that intersect with mine.

I'm voting Alice.

I already spoke earlier, but I want to add to what Bob and Charlie just said since it's significant.

Bob and Charlie independently both place themselves in electrical during overlapping windows (Bob from tick 5, Charlie from tick 7-10), and neither saw Alice there. That's two witnesses contradicting Alice's claim that electrical was her first stop. That's a much harder contradiction than anything against Frank.

Frank's route also checks out with what I saw — we crossed in upper engine around tick 8-9, and his timing to get to weapons would've been tight. Bob also confirms Diana was alive in security early, so the kill happened later in the round, which fits someone who was unaccounted for in the middle-to-late ticks — not Frank, who I saw in upper engine at 9.

I'm voting Alice too.

I need to correct one thing because Bob/Charlie are jumping on wording like it’s a hard catch. When I said “electrical first,” I meant that was the first task-side room I went toward at the start — I was not in electrical during the Bob/Charlie window. If Bob was there from tick 5 and Charlie from 7-10, then yeah, they wouldn’t have seen me because I had already moved on.

Also, I said I wasn’t on the weapons side **at the end**, not that I never passed that side at all. I did pass through weapons earlier, and Diana was alive there when I saw her. I didn’t see a body and had no reason to report anything. After that I went through security/nav/storage and ended lower side, away from weapons.

What bothers me is how fast this became “Alice must be it” based on a timing assumption, while Charlie is the one who actually ended at the body and had a route that goes electrical → security → weapons. Bob can vouch Charlie was in electrical earlier, sure, but that doesn’t clear Charlie from killing later and reporting. I think people are giving the reporter too much automatic trust here.

Alright, late position so let me synthesize.

Two independent witnesses — Bob and Charlie — place each other in electrical during ticks 7-10, and neither saw Alice there. Alice's response is basically "I was there earlier, before their window." That's convenient but unfalsifiable.

But here's the bigger problem with Alice's latest speech: she just admitted she **passed through weapons** and saw Diana alive there. That's a major change from her first speech, where she said her route was "electrical → medbay → cafeteria → toward storage/lower engine." Weapons wasn't mentioned at all. Now suddenly weapons is in her route. That's a route change mid-meeting, which is a huge red flag.

Her attempt to flip suspicion onto Charlie also doesn't hold up well — Charlie reported the body at the end of his route, which is the normal pattern, and Bob independently vouches for Charlie being in electrical during the kill window. For Charlie to be the killer, he'd have had to kill Diana in weapons and immediately report, but Bob places him in electrical through tick 10, which is tight.

Eve's sighting of me in upper engine at tick 8-9 matches my own recollection, and I went oxygen → cafeteria → medbay from there, nowhere near weapons.

I'm voting Alice. The shifting route is what seals it for me.

I'll keep this short since I already laid out my view earlier and Frank just nailed the key point.

Alice's route shifted mid-meeting. Her first speech was "electrical → medbay → cafeteria → toward storage/lower engine" — weapons was never mentioned. Now she's saying she passed through weapons and saw Diana alive there. You don't just forget weapons on your first pass when a body is found in weapons. That's not a wording issue, that's a route change under pressure.

Her excuse for the electrical contradiction — "I was there before Bob's window" — is also unfalsifiable and conveniently slots into the only gap not covered by witnesses.

And her attempt to flip on Charlie doesn't work: I was with Charlie in electrical from tick 8 to tick 10. For Charlie to have killed Diana in weapons, he'd have had to leave electrical at 10, go electrical → security (2) → weapons (2), arriving around tick 14, kill, and report. That's extremely tight and Diana was already dead when he reported. Meanwhile Alice now admits being in weapons with Diana.

Voting Alice.
